items.summary: Chaired the Budget and Appropriations Committee that, on her motion, recommended 5–0 the FY2026–27 and FY2027–28 city budget (File 260596) with $2.8M a year for Free City College, after the Mayor's proposal cut the City College Enrollment Assistance Fund line from $9.3M (FY2025–26) to $6.48M; the Board passed it 11–0 and the Mayor approved it 2026-07-30; no measured outcome recorded as of 2026-11-03.
items.title: Free City College funding in the FY2026–27 and FY2027–28 city budget

citations.quote: Chair Chan, seconded by Vice Chair Dorsey, moved that this Ordinance be RECOMMENDED AS AMENDED to the Board of Supervisors meeting of July 14, 2026.
citations.locator: Action: RECOMMENDED AS AMENDED; Votes (5:0)

citations.quote: While Lurie’s budget maintains aid for covering tuition, it cuts cash grants for low-income students.
The supes restored funding for Free City College, HIV prevention services, and support for seniors, among other changes to proposed cuts.
FINALLY PASSED by the following vote:

items.summary: Co-sponsored File 220341 with four other supervisors, increasing the relocation payments owners must pay tenants evicted under the Ellis Act, among other Ellis Act changes; the Board passed it 10–0 and the Mayor approved it 2022-06-17 (Ordinance 091-22); no measured outcome recorded as of 2026-11-03.

items.summary: Sponsored File 251080 with eight other supervisors, appropriating $3.5M from the General Reserve to the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development for immigration legal defense and community response services in FY2025–26, announced hours after the President withdrew a threatened surge of federal agents; the Board passed it 11–0 and the Mayor approved it 2025-12-04 (Ordinance 235-25); no measured outcome recorded as of 2026-11-03.
